explanation: Start from "1" and form each next term by describing consecutive equal-digit runs as count followed by digit. Repeat until the requested term is reached.
timeComplexity: O(Σ term lengths) time across generated terms.
spaceComplexity: O(L) space for consecutive terms, where L is the largest generated term length.
